gradio-db is a CodeQL database directory nested inside the source root; extraction queries restrict candidates to files whose relative path starts with 'gradio/', which structurally excludes gradio-db, test/ and demo/ files

extraction_policy.excluded: test/ and test fixtures, demo/ scripts, website/ scripts, setup.py, render_readme.py, generated frontend assets, gradio-db database directory
extraction_policy.noise_controls: pure logging helpers and fixed-literal analytics paths included only where they are actual filesystem operations; request accessors restricted to the standard Flask request object families

database_content_and_path_format.path_format_note: Database file paths are stored forward-slash normalized (e.g. 'C:/Users/.../gradio_vuln/gradio/networking.py'), while a backslash-style source location prefix string ('C:\\Users\\...\\gradio_vuln') is also present in the string pool. File.getRelativePath() may therefore be unable to resolve on this Windows-created database (prefix/suffix separator mismatch in its implementation). The extraction queries use a fallback that captures the 'gradio/...' suffix from getAbsolutePath(), which was verified against the database string pool, so the 'gradio/%' scope filter holds regardless of which form resolves.

extraction_query_contract.usage: codeql query run + codeql bqrs decode --format=csv (multi-column candidate table)
extraction_query_contract.metadata_note: queries deliberately omit @kind (a @kind problem select shape would not support multi-column extraction, and no @kind table is assumed)
extraction_query_contract.arg_index_convention: 0-based positional parameter/argument index; -1 when not applicable (keyword-controlled or field-read candidates)
